matching: case-insensitive whole-word keyword match (Unicode NFC) on sku.category, sku.title, listing.title, sku.description, video.product_name, video.product_category and bench.category; a keyword preceded by a negation (không chứa, không có, ko, free, no, without, 0%) or followed by -free is ignored

statuses.prohibited: the source says the product may not be sold or promoted; a match is a detector hit (needs_review)
statuses.restricted_requires_approval: the source says the category needs platform approval; approval status is not an input yet, so a match is only a candidate that Decisions or the policy reviewer must confirm
statuses.covered_elsewhere: listed for completeness; another rule already checks it, so it never triggers this rule
